user.title: Connect to your SMA inverter
user.description: Enter the address of the ESP32 Bluetooth bridge and the Bluetooth address of the inverter. The inverter's Bluetooth radio sleeps when there is no sun, so set up in daylight.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the ESP32 that runs the SMA Bluetooth bridge firmware.
data_description.port: TCP port of the bridge. The default is 9900.
data_description.bt_address: Bluetooth address of the inverter, for example 00:80:25:AA:BB:CC.
data_description.password: The inverter's user password. The SMA default is 0000.

reconfigure.title: Change the bridge or the inverter address
reconfigure.description: Change where the bridge and the inverter are. The settings are checked against the same inverter, so do this in daylight.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the ESP32 that runs the SMA Bluetooth bridge firmware.
data_description.port: TCP port of the bridge. The default is 9900.
data_description.bt_address: Bluetooth address of the inverter, for example 00:80:25:AA:BB:CC.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the inverter password again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the password. Enter the correct user password. The inverter's Bluetooth radio sleeps when there is no sun, so do this in daylight.

data_description.password: The inverter's user password. The SMA default is 0000.

error.bridge_unreachable: Cannot connect to the bridge. Check the host and port and that the ESP32 is on the network.
error.bridge_busy: The bridge is busy with another connection. Try again in a minute.
error.inverter_unreachable: The bridge cannot reach the inverter over Bluetooth. The inverter's Bluetooth radio sleeps when there is no sun, so try again in daylight and check the Bluetooth address.
error.cannot_connect: The connection to the inverter failed. Try again.
error.protocol_error: The bridge or the inverter sent data that this integration does not understand.
error.invalid_bt_address: This is not a Bluetooth address. Use the form 00:80:25:AA:BB:CC.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different inverter than the one that was set up. Add it as a new device instead.

init.title: SBFspot options
init.description: The inverter is only read while the sun is up (from 15 minutes before sunrise to 15 minutes after sunset).

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two readings of the inverter. Minimum 30, maximum 3600.
